title: Each type on a road trip to the north
caption:
Snow trip to the north: one car, sixteen personalities.

One made a PDF nobody opened. One checked the snow chains twice. One wants to stop at every viewpoint. And one is first out of the car, first into the snow and first to slip, laughing.

Tag your road trip group and decide who's driving. (Not the Jaanbaz.)

Which one are you on the way to the mountains?

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
